description: This file contains controller functions for handling account-related API endpoints in a Node.js application, including fetching all accounts for a user and fetching a single account by ID.

methods.name: getMyAccounts
methods.description: Fetches all accounts owned by the authenticated user and returns them as JSON.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Fetches a single account by ID for the authenticated user and returns it as JSON.
